products.name: Terminology Approval Queue
products.product: A focused translation terminology approval workflow workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: boutique translation agencies and localization project teams
products.problem: Translators raise terminology questions in comments and messages, but client answers are not always normalized, approved, and propagated into the glossary before more work continues.
products.valueProposition: Turns translation terminology approval workflow into a visible operating queue so every terminology question receives an authoritative decision that is applied to the glossary and affected translation work.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets translation terminology management, glossary approval workflow, localization term query, and translation termbase review searches.

products.name: Reviewer Handoff Tracker
products.product: A focused translation reviewer handoff tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: boutique translation agencies and localization project teams
products.problem: Files move among translator, editor, subject reviewer, client, and production teams without a consistent package, version, acceptance, or returned-comment record.
products.valueProposition: Turns translation reviewer handoff tracking into a visible operating queue so every review handoff transfers the correct version, scope, references, deadline, and explicit acceptance to the next reviewer.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets translation review workflow, localization reviewer handoff, translation file tracking, and linguistic review management searches.
